items.text: Fixed a null‑reference crash when using the Wire Tool, restoring normal placement and interaction.
Resolved pooling issues with Storage Adaptor containers, preventing items from disappearing or becoming inaccessible.
Fixed invisible building blocks that could not be seen or interacted with after placement.
Corrected the catapult projectile clipping bug that caused shots to disappear off‑map, ensuring damage is applied as intended.
Added CZ‑721 backstory, optional conversations, and mission‑plan records to the Extraction storyline.
Refined Extraction mission interactions: added hold‑E movement/camera lock, 5‑second ledger reads, delayed material consumption, expanded mission card UI, and preserved safe‑pocket items on load.
Introduced loot reveal mechanics and ensured the first loot item appears correctly without hotbar outline artifacts.
Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, emit flashing/beeping signals, launch dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.
Added hotbar action progress indicators and aligned third‑person reload animations for clearer combat feedback.
Raids will now refuse to start if a raid map is missing, preventing crashes and ensuring proper map loading.
Loot now has explicit scrap values and displays its worth on the UI.
Supplies shop prices increased and every item now has a defined value; loot above crafted gear is prioritized.
Furniture contains its own loot, blueprints have weight, and loot pricing reflects item type.
Guard and enemy loot are tiered, giving rewards based on enemy type and monument guard tier.
Safe pocket counts toward carried weight and is shown next to looted items.
Main inventory size is halved on extraction maps, reducing how much you can carry during raids.
Scout drones now patrol small monuments, emit a light, can search for players, and have health, raising alarms when spotted.
Monument guards are organized by tier, with weaker factions placed under scientists.
Outpost is excluded from the standard raid map.
Outpost added to the extraction map, with more monuments and a new 3k procedural map scene for extraction raids.
Extraction balloons are now marked on the map with a countdown timer and close sequentially.
After a raid the map is cleared and extracted loot is banked in a stash; raiders spawn at raid start.
Third‑person attack alignment bug fixed, improving hit detection in third‑person view.
Players can no longer deploy structures while crafting, preventing unintended exploits.
Reload progress bar now appears beside the weapon in shoulder‑camera view.
Fixed first‑person turn‑in‑place rotation being applied twice per frame, eliminating visual popping.
Resolved a NullReferenceException crash in the water‑wheel interaction menu.
Fixed the admin vending‑machine UI “Remove All” popup so it can be interacted with.
Corrected edge‑case rotation errors for swimming NPCs and simple sharks, preventing zero‑rotation glitches.
Fixed a rare case where CH‑47 cargo crates could land on top of power‑line poles at the power plant.
Fixed BaseEntity.OnValidate assigning a nested entity’s model to its parent, ensuring correct visual representation.
Fixed terrain clipping issues in Nuclear Missile Silo entrances, preventing doors and tunnels from being blocked.
Increased the bounding box of apartment buildings to prevent placement issues caused by an undersized bounds.

2026-11-16.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

items.text: Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.
Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.
Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.
A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.
Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.

2026-11-15.summary:
### Missions & Interactions
- Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.

### Drones
- Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.

### Raiding
- Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.

### NPC & AI
- A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.

### Loot & UI
- Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.

items.text: Loot now has value‑based pricing, furniture containers have their own specific contents, and blueprints count toward inventory weight.
Each enemy type now drops its own unique reward, including monument guards.
Hotbar now shows an action progress bar, indicating how long actions like building or using items will take.
Console window is now resizable and includes a blurred backdrop, making command input clearer and UI more flexible.
Error overlay stacking now respects stack‑trace order, ensuring error messages are displayed correctly.
Fixed third-person attack alignment, ensuring attacks now line up correctly with target direction.

2026-11-14.summary:
### Loot & Economy
- Loot now has value‑based pricing, furniture containers have their own specific contents, and blueprints count toward inventory weight.

### Combat & Enemies
- Each enemy type now drops its own unique reward, including monument guards.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Hotbar now shows an action progress bar, indicating how long actions like building or using items will take.
- Console window is now resizable and includes a blurred backdrop, making command input clearer and UI more flexible.
- Error overlay stacking now respects stack‑trace order, ensuring error messages are displayed correctly.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Fixed third-person attack alignment, ensuring attacks now line up correctly with target direction.
